data.title: The F1FTH Tower
data.about:
The F1FTH is Object 1's upcoming project, located in District 16 of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). The tower features 36 floors, with the ground level dedicated to parking and retail areas, a podium floor for amenities, and the rest of the stories for residential purposes. The F1fth Tower floor plan boasts studio, 1, and 2-bedroom ultra-luxury apartments. The amenities are inspired by the four natural elements: fire (BBQ area steam rooms and saunas), water (pools), air (playground and gym), and earth (lush green gardens).

Get ready for top-notch family time at The F1fth Tower Apartments, where you will find the best convenience and comfort. The F1th Tower's location in the heart of JVC provides residents easy access to many city landmarks, such as Dubai Miracle Garden, The Els Club, and the Mall of the Emirates.

location_tile.title: Experience family-friendly living in the heart of Dubai at Jumeirah Village Circle
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
F1FTH Tower is situated in Jumeirah Village Circle. This vibrant community appeals to a diverse demographic, including families, young couples, and singles. Expatriate families, in particular, favor JVC for its array of schools, parks, and fitness centers. Additionally, real estate investors are drawn to the area due to its attractive pricing and high rental yields.

  • 6 minutes - Five Jumeirah Village Hotel
  • 7 minutes - The First Collection at Jumeirah Village Circle
  • 15 minutes - Mall of the Emirates
  • 22 minutes - Palm Jumeirah
  • 21 minutes - The Walk JBR
